Source [S2] confirms that BAD-NeRF represents motion with start and end poses, linearly interpolates intermediate poses in SE(3), renders a sequence of sharp images along this trajectory, and synthesizes the blurred image by averaging these virtual sharp images. It also states that both NeRF and camera motion trajectories are estimated jointly, addressing the challenge of inaccurate poses from blurred images. All specific facts in the claim are present in the provided evidence.
